name: ngrams
description:
Every run of `n` words over all phrases, counted: a table ngram, count, docs, sum and forms.

The column count holds the occurrences; docs, in how many texts (rows of the input before split-text cut them) the gram occurs at least once; sum, with `weight`, the weight; forms, with `lemmas`, the word forms met for the gram, most frequent first, joined by ', ' («диваны, диван»), for a gram of several words its distinct spellings, at most 5.

The words are those of split-text: punctuation at the edges of a word is dropped («руб.» is «руб»), a sign such as ★ is no word, a number with inner points, commas or hyphens is one word («31.03.2026»). Sorted by count, biggest first, then by ngram. Words are compared in any case and with ё as е.
n: how many words in a gram.
lemmas: count lemmas of the words («диваны» is «диван»).
stopwords: on, every word counts; off (--no-stopwords), the grams are made of the words that are no stopwords, and a stopword between two of them stays inside the gram («купить диван в москве» gives «купить диван» and «диван в москве»); stopwords are found in any case.
weight: a column of numbers of the table (a frequency); sum adds its value once per occurrence.

The step counts the working column; the table replaces the current one, its column ngram is the working one.

Example: semkit read core.csv ngrams write out.csv
